headline: Méliuz Sells 78 Bitcoins to Fund Share Buyback Program on B3
summary: Brazilian technology company Méliuz sold 78 bitcoins from its reserves to finance a share buyback program on the B3 stock exchange.
why: Corporate treasury adjustments involving cryptocurrency sales to fund equity buybacks directly alter capital allocation and balance sheet liquidity.

impacts.name: Méliuz
impacts.why: Executing a share buyback program typically signals management confidence and supports share prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Liquidating corporate bitcoin holdings to fund a share repurchase program provides direct capital return signals to equity investors.
